# Christopher A. Coons Watchdog File

Subject: Christopher A. Coons, Democrat, DE, running for U.S. Senate in 2026
Current office: U.S. Senate DE
Compiled: 2026-10-23 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
Status: queued for hand research, priority 2. This file holds the roster facts, the office levers, and FEC pipeline data when the pipeline has run. It is not yet a finished Tier 2 profile.

## Race

Race status: nominee. Rating: Cook: Solid D. Current holder of the seat: Chris Coons.
Opponents: Michael Katz, Republican.
Roster note: won Sept 15 Dem primary over three challengers
